an3.84:1.1: 85 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an3.84:1.2: athakho aññataro vajjiputtako bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so vajjiputtako bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.84:1.3: sādhikamidaṃ bhante diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaḍjhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati
an3.84:1.5: sakkhasi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhituṃ
an3.84:1.9: tasmā tiha tvaṃ bhikkhu tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhassu
an3.84:2.1: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu adhisīlampi sikkhissasi adhicittampi sikkhissasi adhipaññampi sikkhissasi tassa tuyhaṃ adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyissati doso pahīyissati moho pahīyissati
an3.84:2.2: so tvaṃ rāgassa pahānā dosassa pahānā mohassa pahānā yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ na karissasi yaṃ pāpaṃ taṃ na sevissasīti.
an3.84:3.1: athakho so bhikkhu aparena samayena adhisīlampi sikkhi adhicittampi sikkhi adhipaññampi sikkhi.
an3.84:3.2: tassa adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyi doso pahīyi moho pahīyi
an3.84:3.3: so rāgassa pahānā dosassa pahānā mohassa pahānā yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ nākāsi yaṃ pāpaṃ taṃ na sevīti.
